testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect Sketch ribbon while editing an existing sketch: tmp/obk-3956-scenarios/features/application/ribbon-command-availability/ribbon-command-availability.feature:25:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect Sketch ribbon while editing an existing sketch ✔ Given a part containing an existing sketch is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And sketch edit is inactive ✔ When the user opens the existing sketch from the model browser ✔ Then the Sketch ribbon tab is selected ✔ And the 2D sketch workspace shows the existing profile ✔ And Create, Modify, Pattern, Constrain, Insert and Format groups are displayed ✔ And Finish is available to exit sketch editing ✔ When the user selects Line ✔ Then the Line command prompt requests a start point ✔ And the Line tooltip describes line and arc creation ✔ When the user exits sketch editing with Finish ✔ Then the previous part workspace and ribbon context return ✔ And the existing sketch remains in the model browser
